''See also: [[Kameira Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kameira are diverse, non-human and non-Elder creatures that have inhabited the world for millennia. They manifest in various animalistic forms, including birds, fish, serpents, mammals, and insects. While they are biologically unrelated to one another, all species share the miraculous ability to manipulate their natural environments through a force known as [[Intent]]. This supernatural control varies by habitat: sky-dwelling species like the Windwatcher or Stormwing can influence air and gravity, sea creatures such as [[Deepstriders]] command [[water]], forest dwellers may manipulate vegetation, and others can control [[stone]] or fire. Kameira play significant roles in human society through various forms of exploitation and integration. They are hunted for their valuable parts, such as [[scales]], claws, or crystallized hearts, which are used in alchemy to create powerful objects or potions. Some humans undergo alchemical processes to replace limbs with Kameira appendages, granting them enhanced physical abilities and [[binding]] them to the [[Guild]]. Others utilize Kameira for transportation or combat, either through direct bonding or by using specialized equipment like flying devices adorned with their feathers. Additionally, some individuals can host the power of multiple Kameira within their own bodies through a [[Vessel]], though this often results in internal conflict and physical devastation.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A Kameira is a creature of non-human or non-Elder origin capable of manipulating the world through seemingly supernatural means. These lion-like beings possess heads of sterling silver and bright red, spiked claws, though they are known to fly only during lightning storms. While [[Greenwardens]] work closely alongside them, these creatures can also be hunted by individuals like [[Calder]] or used through a [[Vessel]] by those who are [[Soulbound]]. During their migrations, Kameira can reduce ships to matchsticks, and even the alchemically preserved heart of an Elder-tainted infant can be fashioned into jewelry. Throughout these events, the Kameira's unique ability to wield power freely is demonstrated by various figures, including a cook and the returning [[Jarelys Teach]] upon her Kameira bird.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Kameira are ancient beings that have inhabited the planet as long as, or perhaps longer than, humanity and the [[Elders]]. These creatures can take many forms, such as birds, fish, furred beasts, or serpents, and possess the ability to manipulate natural forces like gravity, air, and [[water]]. Beyond their roles as fast transport vehicles or arena fighters, they are potent forces that can reside within others, such as the strength found in [[Meia]]'s [[blood]]. While some Kameira are depicted in carvings or integrated into the bodies of the [[Imperial Guard]], the entity within [[Meia]] eventually resisted her attempts at control.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Kameira are a type of creature found on the [[Aion]] islands that can take many forms, including wolves, [[Hydras]], Icewinders, or Brightwolves. These beings are known to attack villages and can manifest as slithering entities of [[Shadow|shadow]] and liquid, or as large creatures capable of using [[Intent]] to ignite fires. While legends claim their hides consist of gold [[scales]], they are also associated with draconic eyes and exist in various modified forms. The power of a Kameira is found within [[Jerri's Vessel]] and her Awakened earring, which holds the mated power of a Kameira and a notorious Elder. Although they are formidable enough that [[Champions]] can tear [[giant]] specimens apart by hand, it has been noted that certain sparks seen by [[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] were not actually Kameira.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Kameira are blue-scaled creatures the size of a bear that possess unique powers. Because of these abilities, tribes within the [[Dylian mountain range]] hunt them, and they are a group that even the [[Imperial Guard]] is capable of fighting. To become a [[Soulbound]], an individual must possess a measure of power derived from either an Elder or a Kameira. This connection is seen in the staff used by [[Mekendi Maxeus|Maxeus]], which contains the [[blood]] of a flame-controlling Kameira and the crystallized heart of an ancient member of the species. Furthermore, some members of the [[Imperial Guard]] are noted to be missing their own Kameira parts.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Kameira are creatures that fight across both the skies and the waves, possessing incredible eyesight and being utilized by [[Imperial Guards]] for surveillance. While some guards use flying specimens and [[Alchemists|alchemists]] employ leashed ones, a rogue Kameira is dangerous enough to drive a ship into an island. These beings can donate sensory gifts, and [[Jarelys Teach]] even replaced her own heart with one. A clash between a Kameira's heart and destructive [[Intent]] can trigger transformations, such as when the remaining [[Intent]] of the species allows [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] to float using his wings. Additionally, Kameira refers to a species of rice that can be blessed and alchemically enhanced, a concept that [[Jerri]] fears.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kameira are versatile creatures that include the [[Stonefang]] variety and the bird-like Windwatcher. These beings can be tamed, though they necessitate specialized medication and careful maintenance. Capable of drifting across the ocean floor or stalking jungle trees while remaining invisible, they possess unique biological traits that allow their sight to be embedded into weapons. Various guild members even incorporate [[Kameira limbs]] into their own bodies, while others utilize the creatures to transport messengers.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A Windwatcher is a type of bird [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kameira]] require special care and medication.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A weapon can be embedded with the sight of a [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Kameira]] is a creature that can stalk jungle trees while invisible.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A [[Kameira]] is a creature that can drift over the ocean floor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Guild]] members have limbs of [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Messengers arrive on [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
